text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important goal is text understanding, which means a computer can find meaning in what we write. NLP also makes translation possible, so we can change text from one language into another quickly. Another useful use is sentiment analysis, where a computer decides if a message is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people, answer questions, and give help. Thanks to NLP, machines can work with language in ways that feel more natural and useful every day.
